*There is a known issue affecting the number of licenses consumed by this camera. This issue is fixed in SC 5.9.0.0*. There is a configuration option in the WebUI of the camera (Setup -> Image and Display) to set the Imaging mode to "Per-head". The default state is that imaging modes are applied across all heads.
Even with this option enabled, there are some settings that are global rather than per-head (such as WDR & Flicker control). Other settings (such as brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness) will be on a per-head basis provided the webUI has been set to "per-head" imaging mode. . . .

This allows an S74 camera to be extended with audio as well as switching input and output functions.

For the audio output, either the connector can be used to connect a (passive) speaker, or the line-out port can be connected to the line-in port of an audio amplifier.
